invariants.D02-INV-ADMITTED-REALIZATION: coefficients are judged on the stored f32 values, with exact gain and intermediate-range bounds
invariants.D02-INV-BAND-POLICY: tweeter, woofer and sub roles must meet their stop-band guards
invariants.D02-INV-DC: DC rejection follows y[n] = x * R^n
invariants.D02-INV-DESIGN: crossover coefficient designs match an independent bilinear-transform calculation
invariants.D02-INV-FAIL-MUTED-UNSAFE: an unsafe profile switch leaves the board muted until a valid profile is admitted
invariants.D02-INV-FAULT-LATCH: a thermal fault ramps to silence, stays latched, and clears only after cooling
invariants.D02-INV-GOLDEN-RESPONSE: golden impulse and step responses of the admitted realization match an independent f64 reference
invariants.D02-INV-LIMITER: limiter attack and release follow their one-pole closed forms
invariants.D02-INV-MALFORMED: malformed or unstable calibration is refused with the exact reason and the board stays muted
invariants.D02-INV-MAX-GAIN: gain ceiling caps trim * user gain
invariants.D02-INV-NO-ALLOC: rendering a block performs no allocator calls
invariants.D02-INV-OUTPUT-CEILING: the hard output ceiling bounds a limiter overshoot and counts it
invariants.D02-INV-PERSISTENCE: thermal and limiter history survive seek, reconnect, source replacement and profile switch
invariants.D02-INV-UNKNOWN-BOARD: an unknown board or a missing calibration comes up fail-muted and never unmutes
